name: sdrfndrf_generate_otp
description: Sends OTP for SDRF/NDRF authentication. Does NOT verify OTP. Fails if Aadhaar invalid.

name: sdrfndrf_verify_otp
description: Verifies OTP and returns session_token. Does NOT check disaster status. Fails if OTP expired or incorrect.

name: sdrfndrf_check_disaster_status
description: Checks whether a disaster has been officially declared for a location. Returns disaster_status ('not_declared', 'declared', 'active', 'closed'), disaster_type, and affected areas. Claims are valid ONLY if disaster is declared. Requires session_token. Does NOT submit claims. Fails if location is invalid.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: sdrfndrf_check_location_eligibility
description: Verifies whether the farmer's location falls within the officially declared affected area. Requires session_token. Disaster must be declared. Does NOT submit claims. Fails if disaster not declared or location not in affected zone.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

land_parcel_id.description: Unique identifier of the affected land parcel.

name: sdrfndrf_report_damage
description: Reports disaster-related crop/property damage. Transitions claim_status to 'reported'. Must be within time window. Location must be in affected zone. Requires session_token. Does NOT submit formal claim. Fails if disaster not declared, location ineligible, or reporting window expired.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: sdrfndrf_submit_claim
description: Submits a formal relief claim based on a reported damage event. Transitions claim_status to 'submitted'. Damage must be reported first. SDRF/NDRF relief is separate from PMFBY insurance. Requires session_token. Does NOT approve claims. Fails if damage not reported or duplicate claim exists.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

claim_id.description: Unique identifier of the relief claim generated during reporting.

name: sdrfndrf_track_claim_status
description: Tracks claim status ('not_reported' through 'compensated'). Requires session_token. Does NOT modify claim. Fails if claim_id invalid.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

claim_id.description: Unique identifier of the relief claim.

name: sdrfndrf_track_survey_status
description: Tracks government survey/verification status. Returns survey_status ('not_started', 'scheduled', 'in_progress', 'completed'). Requires session_token. Does NOT initiate surveys. Fails if claim_id invalid or no survey assigned.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: sdrfndrf_get_assessment_result
description: Retrieves damage assessment results from official survey. Includes damage_severity, affected area, and estimated loss. Requires session_token. Does NOT modify assessment. Fails if survey not completed.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: sdrfndrf_track_payment
description: Tracks relief payment status ('not_initiated', 'pending', 'credited', 'failed'). Relief disbursed only after approval. Requires session_token. Does NOT initiate payments. Fails if claim not approved.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: sdrfndrf_upload_evidence
description: Uploads structured damage evidence for a claim. Requires session_token. Claim must be in 'reported' or 'submitted' status. Does NOT approve claims. Fails if claim status is beyond 'submitted' or evidence is malformed.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: sdrfndrf_calculate_relief_amount
description: Calculates estimated relief amount based on severity, damage extent, and disaster type. Requires session_token. Assessment must be completed. Does NOT disburse relief. Fails if assessment not completed.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: sdrfndrf_check_claim_window
description: Checks whether the reporting window is still open for a disaster event. Returns deadline and remaining time. Requires session_token. Does NOT extend the window. Fails if disaster not declared.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: sdrfndrf_raise_grievance
description: Raises grievance. Categories: 'claim_rejected', 'survey_delay', 'incorrect_assessment', 'payment_delay', 'eligibility_issue'. Must check status first. Requires session_token. Fails if invalid category.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.

name: sdrfndrf_track_grievance_status
description: Tracks SDRF/NDRF grievance. Requires session_token. Fails if grievance_id invalid.

session_token.description: Token returned after Aadhaar OTP authentication. Required for all tools except authentication.
